name: dyslexia-reading-assistant
description: Chrome Extension to assist reading for people with dyslexia using custom fonts, typography tuning, focus mode, TTS, and AI text simplification.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-assets.js && tsc && node scripts/build-extension.js && node scripts/copy-manifest.js
scripts.pack: npm run build && powershell Compress-Archive -Path dist/* -DestinationPath Dyslexia_Reader_Extension.zip -Force
